description: This file declares the interface for a WebSocket client component, including configuration structures, function prototypes for initialization, control, messaging, and connection management, as well as external variables.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources used by the WebSocket client.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_StartClient
methods.description: Starts a WebSocket client instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_StopClient
methods.description: Stops a specific WebSocket client instance.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_AllowConnect
methods.description: Allows the WebSocket client to establish connections.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_ActivateScheduledActions
methods.description: Activates scheduled actions for the WebSocket client.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_QueueBinaryMessage
methods.description: Queues a binary message for transmission.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_GetRetryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the retry count for a specific client instance.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_Main
methods.description: Main thread function for WebSocket client operations.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_IsEndpointConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific endpoint is connected.
